verdict.rationale: Skyfire attaches verified agent identity to each transaction. A kya token travels from search through checkout, so 'an agentic purchase is never anonymous'. kya-pay tokens package agent identity with payment intent, and merchants or bot managers can identify the agent or agent platform. That gives merchants per-order attribution, but no transaction reporting, dashboard filtering, or query-by-agent capability is documented. Missing for 10: merchant-side transaction reporting or filtering by buyer agent, a documented transaction or charge listing API with agent fields, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
